version: 2

updates:
  - package-ecosystem: npm
    directory: '/'
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
      time: '05:00'
    open-pull-requests-limit: 5
    versioning-strategy: increase
    labels: [dependencies]
    commit-message:
      prefix: 'chore(deps)'
      prefix-development: 'chore(deps-dev)'

    groups:
      # Grouped so a week of routine bumps is one reviewable PR against one CI
      # run, rather than a dozen competing branches that each invalidate the
      # others' lockfile.
      minor-and-patch:
        applies-to: version-updates
        update-types: [minor, patch]
      security:
        applies-to: security-updates
        patterns: ['*']

    ignore:
      # Vite+ wraps Vite, Vitest, Oxlint, Oxfmt and tsdown, and pins their
      # versions itself. Bumping them independently breaks the toolchain — they
      # must move together via `vp upgrade`. See AGENTS.md.
      - dependency-name: vite
      - dependency-name: vitest
      - dependency-name: vite-plus
      - dependency-name: '@voidzero-dev/*'
      # Vendored: package.json resolves it from the tarball in vendor/, which a
      # registry range would not replace. See SECURITY.md for why, and for what
      # moving to the registry release would take.
      - dependency-name: comark

  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: '/'
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
      time: '05:00'
    labels: [dependencies, ci]
    commit-message:
      prefix: 'chore(ci)'
    groups:
      actions:
        patterns: ['*']

  # The Dockerfile's base images are pinned by digest, which stops them moving
  # on their own. Without this entry nothing would move them at all, and the
  # image would keep serving an nginx that no longer gets security fixes.
  - package-ecosystem: docker
    directory: '/'
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
      time: '05:00'
    labels: [dependencies]
    commit-message:
      prefix: 'chore(docker)'
    groups:
      base-images:
        patterns: ['*']
    ignore:
      # nginx numbers stable branches even (1.30) and mainline branches odd
      # (1.31), and Dependabot cannot tell them apart. Patch releases and new
      # digests of the pinned branch arrive here; moving to the next stable
      # branch is a deliberate edit.
      - dependency-name: nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged
        update-types: ['version-update:semver-major', 'version-update:semver-minor']
      # The Node major is pinned together in .nvmrc, the workflows and the
      # Dockerfile, and check-toolchain-pins fails when one moves alone.
      - dependency-name: node
        update-types: ['version-update:semver-major']
